title: Date Wheel
description: An iOS-style date picker sheet: three vertical carousels turn like wheels while a month calendar follows along.
steps: Three `orientation="vertical"` carousels with `itemSize` 36; `itemAnimation` sets rows 18° apart on a cylinder with `translateY = R·sin θ` and `rotateX = −θ`.
`snapMode="nearest"` with `snapMomentum` 0.25 handles flicks, and each wheel's `progress` updates the header, calendar and dimmed days while it turns.
`onSnapToItem` rolls February 30 back to the 28th with `scrollTo({ index })`; calendar taps and arrows drive the wheels with `scrollTo`, `next()` and `prev()`.
